title: It Rained Meat In Kentucky 🥩
caption:
It rained MEAT from a clear sky 🥩
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. On 3 March 1876 chunks of meat fell from a clear sky in Bath County, Kentucky. The leading explanation since 1876: a flock of vultures throwing up as they flew over.
Would you have tasted it? 👇
first_comment: Two men actually tasted it. Somebody always has to. 🥩👇
